units.source_text: 正如我多次叙述过的，我十分重视柏木促使我面对人生的那份亲切或恶意。

en.t: As I have recounted many times, I attached great importance to the kindness or malice with which Kashiwagi compelled me to face life.

units.source_text: 中学时代，我曾把高班同学的短剑鞘弄坏了，那时我已经清楚看出自己没有资格面对人生的光明的表面。

en.t: In middle school, when I once damaged the scabbard of an upperclassman's short sword, I had already seen clearly that I was not qualified to face the bright surface of life.

units.source_text: 可是，柏木却第一次教给我一条从内面走向人生的黑暗的近道。

en.t: But Kashiwagi was the first to teach me a shortcut that led from within toward the darkness of life.

units.source_text: 乍看仿佛奔向毁灭，实则意外地富于术数，能把卑劣就地变成勇气，把我们通称为缺德的东西再次还原为纯粹的热能，这也可以叫做一种炼金术吧。

en.t: At first glance it seemed like a rush toward destruction, yet in fact it was unexpectedly rich in stratagems, able to turn baseness on the spot into courage and restore what we commonly call immorality to pure thermal energy; this, too, might be called a kind of alchemy.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，事实上尽管如此，这仍然是人生啊。

en.t: Even so, in fact precisely even so, this was still life.

units.source_text: 它能够前进、获得、推移和丧失。

en.t: It could advance, acquire, shift, and lose.

units.source_text: 即使它称不上是典型的生，也具备生的所有机能。

en.t: Even if it could not be called a typical life, it possessed all the functions of life.

units.source_text: 如果在我们的眼睛所看不见的地方造化赋予我们的所有生都是无目的的，并以此作为前提，那么它同其他通常的生，就愈发是同等价值的生了。

en.t: If, in places our eyes cannot see, all the lives bestowed on us by creation are purposeless, and if we take that as our premise, then this life is all the more equal in value to other ordinary lives.
